reviews.text: I can also confirm the grimacing, impolite attitude, lack of greetings, and the "why did I come here to shop" feeling on the part of the two ladies.
Great selection, open for a long time. Despite its good features, I don't usually feel comfortable here, I only come here when I have to.
I always find what I'm looking for here.

Big store, with a large selection. I can see and experience cat furniture, carriers, litter trays, etc. where size is important, or the difference between different litters, in comparison with others, before I buy. The staff is helpful and polite.
There is a lot of everything, a wide selection.

Huge selection, friendly, correct service with expertise!
Thanks Alex for navigating between dry food, collars and harnesses, all the answers to related questions, and patience!🐕🐶🐾 …

I went to this store to find what I needed for my cats and I found even more. It's very well-stocked; they have absolutely everything for your pets, and the cashier was very helpful.
I think the prices are good; compared to other stores, I think this one is a bit cheaper.

Huge wide selection especially for Dogs and Cats. The prices are very friendly, there are always promotions! The sellers are also very friendly and very helpful! I recommend the Fressnapf store to everyone!

I usually shop here, it's a good place. The salespeople are nice, and I'm especially glad they don't bother me while I'm shopping. However, -1 star for their habit of rearranging the shelves every month for no reason; it's quite chaotic to see what you can find where.

I am very disappointed with the attitude of the employees, I do not recommend this store to anyone. It is not the first time that we have experienced that customers are made to feel like a nuisance rather than helpful in this store. The last time we went in was half an hour before closing. We arrived to shop, my friend was already sorting and searching in the store to buy something. In comparison, instead of helping us, the employees just stared and walked past us. Then, in a bored, urgent voice, they told us to go pay because they were about to close. The cashier also calmly said that she would close the cash register at 8 pm. I completely understand that they close at 8 pm and want to go home, but if they had helped us find the product instead of constantly urging and scolding us, everyone would have finished much sooner! Instead of being humanely guided, the cashier just phlegmatically said at the very end that the product I was looking for was not in stock for kittens.

The funny thing was that in the end the brown-haired cashier refused to say goodbye at all, she just frowned, and the other employee also just said goodbye with her back turned. I can't help but think that they are having a bad day or are frustrated, and that they have to work!

We are not enemies, but paying customers who deserve much more respect than that, especially since we regularly buy expensive things!

On a previous occasion, we wanted to exchange a bag of adult food that we bought by mistake for a kitten one. In the absence of a block, they showed no fairness or humanity, even though all we should have done was take the good stuff off the shelf and check the previous orders on the computer.

Impatient, phlegmatic and inflexible team, a huge disappointment. We will definitely not come here again! Next time I will only buy from the webshop, because we do not like to come back here to collect bad experiences and leave with bad feelings.

With this style they systematically discredit the Fressnapf name and chase away regular customers.
Nice people as always.
I like it because it has a large selection. The prices are also fair, especially when there is a sale on products.

Best choice if you have a cat, they have a wide set of cat food compared to most pet stores. You can also buy display pet furniture on discount! We got an awesome last piece cat tree for only 14k HUF.
Hello, my question is, can you get a large cage for these cats in the store that they can live in at home?
Great selection. The salespeople were very nice and helpful.

I went to the store today, I wanted to buy some bunny-related things, but as a new owner, I didn't know what to buy. I got a lot of help from Alex (I think that's his name), so thank you very much. It seems that the food that Alex recommended worked for the bunny, thank you for that 🥰 …
Thank you again for the kindest service and help today. ❤️ I will be back soon, or we are already here. 😊 …

Due to the size of the store, the selection is narrower than in other Fressnapf stores (e.g. Újbuda Center), but the most commonly needed items are available.
The cashier was extremely nice and helpful.
The attitude towards customers is very poor and they don't sell frozen goods, interestingly they are available in a smaller store. I wouldn't like to come back here again.
Wide selection of goods, polite, helpful service.

It is extremely inflexible that you cannot return incorrectly purchased, completely intact, unopened cans worth more than ten thousand forints, while I also have a block. The sales lady did not say this kindly, but pointed to a posted policy
Excellent service
Friendly staff, clean, normal shop, with fair prices.
Helpful, attentive service.
Good store, with a large selection.

We were told that one of the dogs was not on a leash, a 12 year old dachshund who is very smart, he never leaves our side and we didn't have a leash so we had to go out, so we couldn't go shopping for the dogs
We are not satisfied because the woman working there didn't even speak nicely, she just yelled at us
A pleasant shop with a rich selection. I visit less often due to the lack of parking spaces...
Helpful salespeople, great selection!
There is natural pet food here, always a great selection!
They were very helpful in the store when I was looking for catnip.
It's close to my workplace, helpful salespeople.

I got everything for the kittens, at a good price.
It was clean, the sellers were helpful.
No attention from staff, no advice, standard merchandise

I bought a puppy's outfit at the store, which I returned the next day because unfortunately the product was defective in two places, which I didn't even notice. I couldn't even put it on the dog, I just figured that the new one would be perfect for him in size.
The next day I went into the store and spoke to the store manager, who told me that I caused the damage, because she remembers that she unpacked these outfits and none of them were defective. She turned her back on me and left. They didn't replace the outfit for me, even though the tag was on it and I had the receipt.
They didn't even record my complaint.

Great, huge selection, you can try...
Open on Sundays too.
Huge variety of options, helpful staff
Expensive. But there was no gift certificate before Christmas

I've been going to this store for the same products for years. When I went in today after opening, the cashier greeted me with a friendly smile.
His friendliness lasted until I dared to say that I didn't have any smaller denominations than 10,000.
Then his expression and tone changed.
I really didn't like that.

I have shopped at Fressnapf several times. The salespeople were nice and helpful. The store is tidy and has a pleasant atmosphere. The selection of products is wide. You can almost always park in front of the store. It costs money. There is also a barrier-free entrance.
I've been there several times without getting the usual dog and bird food. I had to go to Újpest to get them, they were there!

I used to go to this store because it had a large selection, even if it was a bit expensive. However, after my experience today, I would not want to go back.

I went in to buy a cat tree, but there was no unopened piece of the model I wanted — only the one on display. I thought that was why I was getting the 2000 HUF discount. I agreed to take the one on display, but I would have needed help to get it to the Bolt I wanted to call, since the cat tree was huge and heavy, and it would have taken a very long time to disassemble. Plus, I was already carrying several heavy bags, which would have been enough for the manager to at least show a little helpfulness.

However, the manager was completely incompetent: he showed no interest in helping or even communicating with me. Even though he was standing right in front of me, he only agreed to talk through the salesperson (who was very nice by the way), but he was already overloaded with other customers and the cashier. Also, the store completely blocked the internet for about 20 meters around the building, and even the store's own wifi was not working properly, so I couldn't call Bolt. The salesperson asked the manager if he could help me with this, and he was extremely rude to her and shouted at her in front of the customers waiting at the checkout. I have never seen such unprofessionalism, lack of empathy and unhelpful attitude.

I finally managed to call the app after going out in the rain and using my own data.

On top of that, the product arrived with a broken part. I assume that's why it was on sale, but this was not mentioned at all during the purchase.

After all of this, I'm giving it 1 star and will never return to this store again.
Everyone was very kind and helpful to me. Thank you very much again to everyone for your kind and patient help. 🩷 …
The store is okay, the selection is adequate, the cashier's manners and mood are variable...
The sales area is spacious. The salespeople are prepared, feel free to ask them questions. There is always a parking space not far from the entrance.
Helpful and prepared staff.
A store with a huge selection, with a friendly salesperson who can give advice. I recommend it!
They are very kind, helpful and there are always promotions. We have 2 cats and they love them very much.
Everything can be found in it.
They are very weak in aquariums, nothing serious, and I see the standard is falling in every area.
Nice service, lots of products
Orderly, clean store. Helpful salespeople.

Today's experience. The lady at the cash register is the only one working. Because "the colleague is having lunch" (which is correct and appropriate and there is no problem with that). The thing is, I had a question, the answer was that "I'm just serving this one customer (at the cash register)", then she serves four more and I wait 15 minutes (because one of the customers put one of their items aside and returned it) for nothing. I've been shopping here for years. That's in the past. It's not 1 star because the colleague really was in a hurry at the cash register. It's advisable not to look at the other person as stupid - and I know there are bigger problems in the world... I didn't like this today. Maybe they'll learn from it if I write it down. Generally, the service here is average anyway. Customers are buying, sellers are helping. Something slipped up today.
The staff is very kind and helpful at all times.

Extremely kind and patient employees, our puppy peed on it, the employee wiped it up without a word. It is very rare to see this in Hungary. The company management can be proud of such employees. Wide selection, competitive prices
Super prices super service wide selection

This store has unfortunately changed. I've been coming here for three years, and it was no problem that we shopped with my Chihuahua puppy, who was always off-leash (he can't wear one due to a trauma). Now, unfortunately, a "woman" who is a stick-snout ("the gentleman"), who is afraid for her job, and therefore extremely rule-following and conformist, has become the manager of the store, who asked for the dog to be put on a leash, saying that I can shop while holding it in my hand. (No, I can't.) My dog ​​doesn't do anything wrong, it's true, you can't say that about an unknown dog, but he will sniff and mark even if he's on a leash. By the way, my dog ​​only sniffs, he doesn't do anything wrong. The rules have a purpose, and they're not selfish, so there could be a little flexibility. So, here it's probably all about money now, and the store has lost its more personal, friendly and homely atmosphere. It's a good thing that other stores don't have this problem, it's true, they recognize regular customers there. Well, I hope it's not Fressnapf's business approach that has changed in general, just this one store. So I don't recommend this place, only to those who don't care about friendliness, only the product. The rest should choose another store.
There are many good things, they are not cheap but they are good.
Very kind and helpful staff!
Good place,  nice and welcoming staff
Great selection but more importantly... Very helpful staff. Thank you!

Tímea was very helpful,
-Fressnapf Váci út-
when I asked for advice about my large, and now still young, puppy.
I asked her for instructions on how to dose dog food!
She was very kind and provided me with prepared advice, which even veterinarians usually don't give.

I thank her very much for her help,
and
this time my suggestion is that she be rewarded with a cash reward for her work in increasing the business's reputation and turnover!

Anna Vas 😊
They are very kind, helpful and have everything that is important for a puppy or any small pet.

A very pleasant and well-organized pet store! A wide selection of food, accessories, and toys for all types of pets. The staff is polite and always ready to help with advice. I was especially pleased that they have high-quality products at reasonable prices. The store is clean, spacious, and easy to find everything you need.
I definitely recommend it to anyone who cares about their pets! 🐶🐱🐰
The sellers are great, they always help.
This is a great store, the best, but it's closed on Sundays, and Google says it's open until 6 p.m. (That's a mistake.)
Kind and professional sellers. Huge selection. We will come here again. :) I recommend it to everyone.
The sellers were very nice.

Dear János!

Thank you for the rating and the stars! :)

Best regards,
Fressnapf-Hungária Kft
Great product selection, great salespeople.
Great selection of produtcs. The staff are friendly and helpful!
Every Fressnapf has something exciting in store. I found a new kind of treat for our dog here too :-)
There is a choice
Friendly service and salespeople, the products are the same as in every store they have!
It's convenient because it's near the market, so you can get everything at once.
Nice staff. Can find different brands of cat and dog food

I just popped in to get some treats for the dog, I've never been here before. It's like being in a self-service store, only the cash register is missing, that would be better because you don't have to wait for it. No one cared when I went in and searched frantically, they get along well with each other...
Nice store for pet food and accessories. I interacted with a nice store attendant, she speaks English fluently and is very professional.
The sellers were very kind and helpful, and they treated our pig with great patience.
I come here regularly, but the salespeople have never been such jerks before, now they are really.
Large selection of dog food, good service
Scents, colors, flavors
There is a lot of stuff to find in the store, but not all sellers treat customers the way they should.
Big Fressnapf with loads of selection

Today, we spent many times the time intended for this, trying to get the bank card terminal, which had seen better days, to work. It did not support telephone payments at all. I recommend that you request a replacement for the apparently 5-6 year old device from the service provider.
There are lots of products to choose from, nice and polite salespeople.
Excellent supply store with friendly staff!
It's not a very big store, but it has a wide variety of products. It's a few minutes walk from the metro.
Friendly service! Helpful salespeople!!!
Well equipped store, fast service
Friendly salespeople, good advice.
Kind, helpful salespeople, well-equipped store.
brutal bad place, bad staff, they have no time to help, they laugh in the back, their phone is in some pitiful shape, and the whole staff. Please close it down
Good selection of what you need for your pet. Very friendly and helpful staff.
I bought a treat for my dog. 🤩🤩 …

I have never experienced such kind, attentive, helpful and proactive service at Fressnapf. I received immediate and exhaustive help in everything, without even having to ask. Until now, I have been to the local store in Gödöllő, where unfortunately I have experienced the opposite every time, and I was starting to think that this was a kind of Fressnapf peculiarity, part of the franchise, you could say. Thank God I was wrong, but it is certain that I will travel 30 minutes from now on, but I will not shop in Gödöllő anymore, only at the Váci út store. I would like to thank the lovely lady for letting me be so pleasantly disappointed!
